facts.Network: Xiamen Torch High-tech Zone / Xiamen High-tech Innovation Angels
facts.Focus: AI, semiconductors, advanced manufacturing, new energy, biomedicine and other deep technologies.
facts.Capital Type: No Guaranteed Capital + Separate Direct Equity Investment Opportunity
facts.Funding / Support: Program free + RMB10K scholarship for ≥90% course completion; strong projects can receive RMB5M–50M direct equity investment opportunities
facts.Funding Trigger: Scholarship based on completion; equity investment is separate selection/IC decision
facts.Equity / Economic Terms: Not a standard equity accelerator; investment decisions are separate.
facts.Official / Must-Have Requirements: China-wide early/mid-stage hardtech or university research commercialization project; AI, semiconductors, advanced manufacturing, new energy, biomed and other future-industry themes.
facts.Strong-to-Have: Full-time founders, clear founder-market fit, a demonstrable MVP, customer validation and explicit milestones and funding needs.
facts.Format: Selection, mentorship, investor connections and industry collaboration.
facts.On-site / Attendance: No standard attendance requirement published. Confirm the current cohort arrangements for Xiamen / China-wide recruitment.
facts.International Founder: Primarily China-focused; international teams should confirm eligibility individually.
facts.Visa / Relocation: No standard visa support published; participants must independently confirm lawful entry and stay for US or European activities.
facts.Deadline / Next Intake: China-wide recruitment for 2026; consult the application page for deadlines.
facts.Application Materials: Team, company, product, market, traction and funding information; consult the current official application form.
facts.Public Contact Route: Use the official application. Do not infer private contact information when none is published.
facts.Foundshore Best Fit: Hardware / Robotics / DeepTech; MedTech / Health / Bio; AI / AI-native; Climate / Energy; primarily at the Early to mid-stage / research commercialization stage.
facts.Foundshore Not Fit: Traditional offline businesses without a scalable technology product
facts.Notes: Running annually since 2019; plans to select approximately 50–60 projects in 2026. More than 30 past projects have received market-based investment.
